verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents creating Payment Links via the API, and its hosted MCP server lets an AI agent "create and manage payment links" in a session, so the payment-link part of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows product or price catalog objects that an agent could provision first, so the story only works as an ad-hoc amount-based payment link. Missing for 10: product catalog API, price object API, an evidenced single-session flow linking product to price to payment link, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven link creation.
